intent: Create a Du Bonheur homepage that makes French pâtisserie craft tactile while preserving Berlin restraint and practical visit intent
businessTruths: Real Du Bonheur products must remain truthful.
antiPrinciples: No synthetic documentary representation of real signature products.

opportunityGaps: Make craftsmanship tactile and sensory online.

references.take: extreme food cropping and whitespace rhythm
references.transform: Use pastry layers as the compositional material.
Translate fabric/material sequencing into pastry lamination and glaze texture.

designRead.business: French pâtisserie in Berlin with serious craft and a physical café visit goal.
designRead.emotionalTarget: Appetite, craft credibility, and quiet pleasure.
designRead.categoryExpectation: Elegant French bakery with polished food photography.
designRead.opportunity: Replace French cliché with tactile craft and Berlin editorial restraint.
designRead.memorableIdea: Pastry texture becomes the graphic and motion system.

visualDensity.rationale: Leave appetite and imagery room to breathe.

editoriality.rationale: Editorial framing differentiates from bakery templates.

concepts.thesis: French craft staged with Berlin editorial restraint.
concepts.memorableIdea: Pastry texture becomes the page grid and transition language.
concepts.businessFit: Balances premium craft with local credibility and visit intent.
concepts.risk: Could become too austere if imagery is under-warm.

concepts.thesis: Precision and process turn the site into a material study of pâtisserie.
concepts.memorableIdea: Measurements, layers, cross-sections, and process marks structure the experience.
